citation.short_title: Melvin-Koushki, The Second Aristotle Turns Astro-Lettrist

content: The Second Aristotle paper calls Afżal al-Dīn b. Ḥabīb Allāh Turka (d. 1583) Ibn Turka's great-great-grandson. It says nothing else on this page or in the pages searched about Ibn Turka's own life, patrons or trials.
